positive_cases.name: created_by_admin
positive_cases.scenario: Account created by a synthetic administrator.
positive_cases.rationale: Creation event matches and no filter applies.

positive_cases.name: created_by_helpdesk
positive_cases.scenario: Account created by a synthetic help desk operator.
positive_cases.rationale: Creation event matches and no filter applies.

negative_cases.name: created_by_provisioning_service
negative_cases.scenario: Account created by the joiner provisioning service.
negative_cases.rationale: Creation event matches but the provisioning filter removes it.

negative_cases.name: account_deleted
negative_cases.scenario: Account deleted during a leaver process.
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier is a deletion, not a creation.

negative_cases.name: password_changed
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier does not match.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
